description: This table records customer reviews for purchased orders, capturing review scores, comments, and timing data.

attributes.review_id: Unique identifier for each customer review.
attributes.order_id: Identifier linking review to its associated order.
attributes.review_comment_title: Optional title for the customer review.
attributes.review_comment_message: Optional customer review text in free form.
attributes.review_creation_date: Timestamp indicating when the review was created.
attributes.review_answer_timestamp: Timestamp when the review received a response.
